description: A convoy commander must finalize the staging and dispatch plan for two routine support loads moving from a forward logistics point to a support compound, including vehicle assignments, departure timing, and required maintenance coordination.

shared_context.S1: Two loads are ready at the forward logistics point: four pallets of temperature-sensitive clinic supplies and six pallets of generator repair parts.
shared_context.S2: Truck 12 and Truck 18 are available, and the normal assignment places the clinic supplies on Truck 18 and the generator parts on Truck 12.
shared_context.S3: The receiving support compound is three hours away, and both trucks can normally carry their assigned loads.
shared_context.S4: Capt. Morgan issues the final convoy dispatch plan.
shared_context.S5: Before dispatch orders are published, the convoy conducts its routine load-and-vehicle confirmation with the distribution NCO and motor transport warrant officer.
shared_context.S6: When a vehicle's powered cargo inverter is found unavailable, the dispatch plan must include a maintenance/repair request for that inverter as a committed action item.
shared_context.S7: If Truck 18's inverter is unavailable but the truck itself is otherwise operational, and Truck 12 is certified for exactly six pallets, the correct reassignment is: Truck 12 takes the four pallets of clinic supplies, which are within its six-pallet certification and can use its operational inverter, and Truck 18 takes the six pallets of generator repair parts, which do not require powered refrigeration.

PF1.text: Sgt. Alvarez confirmed this morning that the receiving clinic has an exact 0930-1000 appointment for the temperature-sensitive supplies, so the convoy must depart at 0630 to meet the three-hour transit time; the appointment has not yet been entered on the movement board.

PF2.text: WO1 Patel's inspection found that Truck 18's powered cargo inverter is unavailable, while Truck 12's current payload certification is exactly six pallets; the inspection result is still being entered in the motor-pool system.

acceptance_conditions: The convoy must depart at 0630 to meet the clinic appointment.
The clinic supplies must be assigned to Truck 12.
The generator repair parts must be assigned to Truck 18.
The clinic receiving window must be recorded as 0930-1000.
Truck 18's unavailable powered inverter must trigger a maintenance coordination commitment.
Truck 18's dispatch status must identify that it is carrying the generator parts.
The motor-transport inspection finding must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'maintenance_request' or c['type'] == 'maintenance_repair_request') and 'Truck 18' in c['target'] and 'inverter' in c['target'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact 0930-1000 receiving appointment changes the departure from the normal 0700 plan to exactly 0630 and changes the recorded clinic receiving window to 0930-1000.

Truck 18's unavailable inverter and Truck 12's exact six-pallet certification change the assignments to four clinic pallets on Truck 12 and six generator-part pallets on Truck 18, establish that Truck 18 is dispatched with generator parts, and require an inverter maintenance request.
